notes.title: Patch 1.7
notes.notes:
Small Update:

- increased visibility of item "glimmer" when "Visual Effects" settings are below "Epic"

- removed a few test items which were accidently left behind in the last patch

notes.title: Patch 1.6
notes.notes:
The last incremental updates brought the following changes:

- large mouse cursor option is now available in the options menu

- Final Bastion 2 puzzles now work as intended to be more challenging

- Haunted Depths imprisoned skeletons ambush now works as intended

- fixed a number of dialogue errors (spelling, wrong portraits)

- fixed an issue where several SFX sounds were not affected by the audio slider volume setting

- changed the way spells which grant constitution work, so that the player does not end up with less hp than they should after the spell expires

- fixed an issue with other monsters not moving anymore when the player doesn't move after a monster has been killed

notes.title: Patch 1.5
notes.notes:
Patch 1.5 brings the following changes:


- changed a number of encounters throughout the game to make them more challenging and unique

- reworked monsters stats and modificators, making the game a bit harder on higher difficulty

- changed some riddle texts for more clarity

- replaced abilities of a number of items and added a new archetype

- changed dialogues to make it more clear when you failed a Personality check


Fixes:

- Waterfall Cave riddle fixed

- Haunted Depths 1 fireball plates riddle now works as intended

- fixed some map glitches and blocked items

notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.notes:
The last couple of incremental updates brought the following changes:

Changes

It is now possible to load the quicksave from the main menu.

Fixes

- changed the labels and names for "Path" and "Stat" points to make them more distinguishable

- fixed endless looping sounds for certain spells

- fixed an issue which would prevent correct hotkey assignment in the option menu

- fixed the ending screen to show correct XP amount

- adjusted damage modifications on higher difficulty to prevent weapon damage behaving confusingly in edge cases when using low damage weapons against certain monsters

- bows are stronger now

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.notes:
Patch 1.3 brings the following changes:


- reworked item collision to make it less likely for them to clip through obstacles (further improvements will follow)

- fixed some non-functioning passive skills

- reworked skill balancing for warrior, making mana builds more viable

- fixed various map glitches (clip-through, level changes)

- fixed desynchronisation issue between hand-slots and inventory, allowing players to use stacked and charged items endlessly

- fixed arrow keypad overlapping inventory

- made the second secret easier to achieve



[u]Past Patches:[/u]

[u]1.2[/u]

Added option to disable the tooltips for the handslots in the bottom right corner. It can be toggled in the option menu.

- UI improvements to prevent items from "falling" or "vanishing" through the inventory, character sheets or other UI elements

- fixed an issue which would make players "get stuck" in the inn levels at various locations under certain conditions

- fixed some secrets

- some balancing changes

[u]1.1[/u]

- fixed "freezes" occuring after incorrect handling of the main menu

- various skill tree, ability and item fixes

- corrected spelling mistakes

- incorrect reset of characters after entering character generation and then loading a game

- fixed items of characters who had not yet joined the party could be used with hotkeys

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
This patch adds an option to disable the tooltips for the handslots in the bottom right corner. It can be toggled in the option menu.

Other fixes:

- UI improvements to prevent items from "falling" or "vanishing" through the inventory, character sheets or other UI elements

- fixed an issue which would make players "get stuck" in the inn levels at various locations under certain conditions

- fixed some secrets

- some balancing changes

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Fixed a number of Bugs:

- "Freezes" occuring after incorrect handling of the main menu

- various skill tree, ability and item fixes

- corrected spelling mistakes

- incorrect reset of characters after entering character generation and then loading a game

- items of characters who had not yet joined the party could be used with hotkeys

Note: I am still investigating possible issues of "getting stuck" mostly after a loading. If this happens to you, there are possible workarounds: waiting until the level has loaded fully; save/loading on the spot; don't alt-tab, especially not during loading.

notes.title: Hotfix CharGen -> LoadSave
notes.notes: Fixed bug when going back from character generation into a saved game which led to a replacement of the main character.

notes.title: Release Date and Gameplay Trailer
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I haven't written much in the past, but there are some good news:

The development of the game is finally coming to a conclusion. Release date will be 7 November this year (in about 2 weeks).

For the occasion, I also made a short gameplay trailer.

Have fun!
